tldr: Neptune through the 3rd house blurs messages, conversations, learning, and daily movement.
body:
When Neptune moves through your 3rd house, it blurs the edges of messages, conversations, errands, siblings, neighbors, learning, planning, and what needs to be said. You may notice more activity in your immediate world: conversations to have, details to track, short trips to make, or a decision that needs clearer words.

Longing, sensitivity, confusion, compassion, avoidance, or idealization may be stronger. It can help you soften where life has become too rigid or overly defended.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for naming the thing that has been circling in your mind.

The caution: Watch for believing the dream so completely that you stop checking the evidence. The risk is getting scattered by every message, detail, or possible interpretation.

Neptune moves through this house for a long chapter. Keep the sensitivity, but stay honest about what is actually happening.
